title: SVM model predicts 28-day mortality in myocardial infarction with malignant arrhythmia
summary: Using 952 patients from MIMIC-IV (28-day mortality 32.46%) and 100 patients from Maoming People's Hospital for external validation, a linear-kernel SVM on eight predictors reached AUC 0.865 internally and 0.898 externally, against 0.771 for a biomarker-only model externally. The external cohort is only 100 patients, the study is retrospective and the authors acknowledge residual treatment confounding.
ai_technology: Linear-kernel SVM on eight predictors, selected among seven machine-learning algorithms

evidence.tested: External validation on 100 patients at Maoming People's Hospital, after development on MIMIC-IV.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and early-prediction value; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A support vector machine predicted 28-day mortality from eight clinical predictors.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
